tools.name: get_basket
tools.description: List what is currently in your basket (inspect the drafted articles/placements before publishing).

tools.name: publish_basket
tools.description: Publish everything in your basket, paying from your account balance. If the balance is short it does nothing and reports how much more is needed. Topping up the balance is done in the dashboard only.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_links, get_article_prompt, order_backlink · Public sink: order_backlink, publish_basket.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_links, get_article_prompt, order_backlink · Public sink: order_backlink, publish_basket

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
